groups.activity: finish The Duviri Paradox; buy Enigma Sense

rows.label: Enigma Sense
rows.note: Drifter upgrade from Acrithis, Dormizone only

conditions: Pick The Duviri Experience, not The Lone Story; Lone Story turns off Enigma puzzles entirely.
bonuses: Enigma Sense puts a map icon and waypoint on nearby Enigmas; buy it before farming.

groups.activity: solve the Archarbor puzzle every time it's up; gather Eevani
groups.meta: 6% per solve, 30% total for some piece

rows.label: Cinta piece (any)
rows.note: main Blueprint, Grip, Lower Limb, Upper Limb or String

conditions: The Archarbor exists only during the Joy, Envy and Sorrow spirals, not Anger or Fear.
Open it by rotating the three Dominus Thrax busts at the island's edges to face the center, then hacking the fourth bust underground.
A squad of 2+ also unlocks 6% multiplayer Enigmas elsewhere in Duviri; solo caps you at 4% single-player puzzles plus the Archarbor.
Take a Decree before extracting; progress and drops save only up to your last Decree.
bonuses: Solving the Archarbor also pays 5 Enigma Gyrum each time.

disclosures.title: drop odds
disclosures.body: Archarbor and multiplayer Enigmas: 6% per piece, 30% total. Single-player Enigmas: the wiki's own drop table gives 4% per piece (20% total), despite prose elsewhere claiming 30% from any puzzle; the table wins.

disclosures.title: why the last piece takes so long
disclosures.body: Every solve rolls one random piece off the same table with no pity. Duplicates are common; people routinely report 4-7 hour sessions stuck on the final piece. Trading covers the gap since every piece is tradeable.

disclosures.title: finding puzzles
disclosures.body: Enigma Sense (once unlocked) waypoints nearby Enigmas. Without it, learn the fixed spawn spots from a community Duviri map, and listen for the Paragrimm owl's distinct sound.
